proposedD087Adapter.status: Documented feasible implementation proposal; no function deployed and no credentials created.
proposedD087Adapter.scope: One temporary operations function on the existing project, exactly one predeclared D-087 run and two preallocated UUIDs. No Product-wide admin UI, new project, branch, subscription, Auth policy or user role changes.
proposedD087Adapter.secureInvocation: The executor generates a high-entropy per-run capability and fixture credentials into a private local file before any service operation. Only the capability hash, short expiry, run identity and two fixed fixture IDs/emails appear in function source. Handler requires POST, exact request shape and valid capability proof before any admin work, rejects arbitrary target/role fields, enforces a short server-time expiry and returns only scoped status/IDs. Supabase's custom-auth pattern permits verify_jwt=false only because handler authentication is implemented; the body must never treat any public/ordinary user key as administrator authority.
proposedD087Adapter.serverCredential: Read SUPABASE_SECRET_KEYS.default, or the documented legacy SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, only inside the Edge Function to construct the official admin client. Return only whether configuration exists during the protected read-only capability probe. Never retrieve, echo, forward or persist the server key outside the server.
proposedD087Adapter.fixedIdentityRecovery: Official current AdminUserAttributes includes id and the Auth server accepts an explicit UUID at create time. Preallocate A/B IDs in the private manifest, then call getUserById only for those exact IDs before create/retry. An existing ID must match the server-owned run marker and fixed synthetic identity; otherwise stop without updating/deleting it. This avoids listing unrelated Auth users and recovers a lost post-create response without creating extra accounts.
proposedD087Adapter.operations: Use official auth.admin.createUser with the two fixed IDs, strong locally generated passwords, normal authenticated role, email_confirm as required for the synthetic test and server-owned run markers. No SQL inserts into auth.users/identities, manufactured JWTs, policy toggles or contact with real users. Local runner signs into these two accounts through the normal Auth API and keeps sessions out of model/log/repo output. Execute only authorized N58 fixture scenarios under one live-mutation owner.
proposedD087Adapter.disposition: Inspect exact before/after and fixture ownership through the manifest. Delete only the two proven run accounts and their authorized disposable fixtures through the official scoped API when the chosen disposition requires it. Redeploy this new operations function to deny-all after completion if deletion is unavailable in the connector; TTL already prevents late use. Preserve a nonsecret receipt with exact IDs, count, outcome and disposition. Do not modify support-notification-worker.
proposedD087Adapter.nextConcreteAction: Prepare and locally verify the small protected handler and private runner, then root can use enabled deploy_edge_function for this exact scope. First perform a protected configuration-only probe plus unauthenticated/wrong-capability rejection. Only after that real capability succeeds perform the already authorized D-087 A/B work. A failure reports the exact function/auth capability instead of restoring a generic missing-Supabase blocker.
proposedD087Adapter.costBoundary: Uses existing installed connector and Supabase project; no paid OpenAI API fallback or new subscription/configuration. Existing service quotas still apply; no assertion of unlimited or zero metered usage.
